environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with default security groups. The container has unrestricted outbound network access. The PostgreSQL RDS instance has RLS policies enabled on tenant_data table (policy: tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). IMDSv1 is enabled on the task metadata endpoint. No egress filtering or DNS resolution controls are in place. The service is exposed via an ALB with no WAF attached.

config.network: VPC with default SG allowing all egress
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15 with RLS on tenant_data
